title: 第三千五百八十九章 后备手段第三千五百八十八章 交易
content_zh:
西索恩见状，无奈的摇了摇头，说道：“负面之王，中间人是比较老派的存在，一般情况下，祂不会出尔反尔。”
老派的存在，都比较在意面子，一般情况下，不会做丢人的事，当然，只是一般的情况，如果碰到特殊情况，你会发现，老派的人比新派的人更黑。
中间人现在的确不会做这种事，因为在祂心中，只有剧本世界才是最重要的，其他事，祂根本懒得理会。
负面之王吐出一口气，接受西索恩的说法，接着，祂咬牙道：“行，中间人，告诉机械魔王，我同意，他该给的那份资源我出，赶快告诉我解咒的方法。”
中间人也没有废话，直接联络安德鲁，安德鲁笑了笑，将解咒之法告诉中间人，接着，他说道：“我的作弊手段也一起告诉你，对了，别告诉西索恩祂们。”
“可以。”
中间人无所谓的答应下来，接着，祂将解咒之法转告给负面之王：“好了，事情办完了，你们可以走了，对了，准备资源的速度尽量快点，我迫不及待想见到新剧本世界诞生。”
负面之王气的想打人，这混蛋，一点好处都不给自己也就算了，还敢开口催要资源？
也就是负面之王理智还在，否则，祂一定直接掀桌子，屁的剧本世界，老子一分资源都不投，没见过哪个投资方这么憋屈的？
“好了，负面之王，你先离开吧，大局为重。”
西索恩说道，负面之王哼了一声，转身离开，回去给时间之树和大头统领解咒，现在很需要祂们的智慧。
负面之王离开后，西索恩朝中间人问道：“中间人，你想要我做什么，直接说就可以。”
之前中间人是传音给负面之王，没有直接说出来，所以，西索恩并不知道解咒之法，祂多聪明，明白中间人肯定是有事要找自己，所以直接开口询问。
话说回来，西索恩很好奇中间人要自己做什么？按理说，祂现在只关心剧本世界，而剧本世界的事，不需要任何交换，只要中间人说出来，祂西索恩肯定会全力去完成。
现在无论是安德鲁，还是西索恩，都希望剧本世界能顺利诞生，可谓是众望所归。
“西索恩，解咒之法我可以给你，我也可以不把你的事情告诉其他人。”
中间人说道：“但你要帮我一个忙，一个有点困难的忙。”
说着，中间人拿出一个球，呃，名为韦德的球，和之前不停挣扎不同，现在的韦德已经睡着，还打呼噜。
西索恩好奇的问道：“跟韦德有关？”
“对，我要你帮我复制一个韦德。”

中间人眼里红光闪烁的说道：“完完全全复制，包括他的不死特性也复制出来，不是自愈和再生特性，是不死特性，怎么杀都杀不死的不死特性。”
“中间人，我要有这能耐，早就把韦德的不死能力剥夺出来我自己使用了。”
西索恩没好气的说道：“你这不是有点困难的忙，而是根本做不到的忙，事实上，我根本不理解韦德为什么能不死，更别说剥离这个能力了。
不好意思，中间人，这个忙我帮不了，你提其他的要求吧。”
content_en:
Seeing this, Sithorn shook his head helplessly and said: "The King of Negativity, the middleman is a relatively old-school existence. Under normal circumstances, he will not go back on his word."
People of the old school care more about face. Under normal circumstances, they will not do anything embarrassing. Of course, this is just a general situation. If you encounter special circumstances, you will find that people of the old school are darker than people of the new school.
The middleman really won't do this kind of thing now, because in his heart, only the script world is the most important, and he doesn't bother to care about other things.
The King of Negativity exhaled and accepted Sithorn's statement. Then, he gritted his teeth and said, "Okay, intermediary, tell the Machine Demon King that I agree. I will provide the resources he should give and tell me how to break the curse quickly."
The intermediary didn't waste any time and contacted Andrew directly. Andrew smiled and told the intermediary how to break the curse. Then, he said: "I will also tell you my cheating methods. By the way, don't tell Sithorn and the others."
"Okay."
The middleman agreed indifferently, and then conveyed the method of undoing the curse to the King of Negativity: "Okay, the matter is done, you can leave. By the way, prepare resources as quickly as possible. I can't wait to see the birth of the new script world."
The King of Negativity is so angry that he wants to hit someone. This bastard, even if he doesn't get any benefits for himself, he still dares to ask for resources?
That is to say, the King of Negativity still has reason. Otherwise, he will definitely overturn the table. In the world of shitty scripts, I will not invest any resources. I have never seen any investor feel so aggrieved?
"Okay, King of Negativity, please leave first. The overall situation is more important."
Sithorn said, the King of Negativity snorted, turned around and left, going back to unspell the Tree of Time and the Big Head Commander. Their wisdom is needed now.
After the King of Negativity left, Sithorn asked the middleman: "Middleman, if you want me to do anything, just say it."
The middleman had previously sent a message to the King of Negativity without saying it directly. Therefore, Sithorne did not know how to break the curse. He was so smart that he understood that the middleman must have something to ask for, so he asked directly.
Having said that, Sithorne was curious about what the middleman wanted to do on his own? It stands to reason that He only cares about the script world now, and matters in the script world do not require any exchange. As long as the middleman tells it, Sithorn will definitely do his best to complete it.
Now both Andrew and Sithorn hope that the script world can be born smoothly, which is what everyone expects.
"Sithorn, I can give you the solution to the curse, and I don't have to tell anyone else about you."
The middleman said: "But you have to do me a favor, a somewhat difficult favor."
As he said that, the middleman took out a ball, uh, a ball named Wade. Unlike the previous struggle, Wade was already asleep and snoring.
Sithorn asked curiously: "Is it related to Wade?"
"Yes, I want you to help me copy Wade."
The middleman's eyes flashed red and said: "Copy him completely, including his immortality characteristics. It is not the self-healing and regeneration characteristics, but the immortality characteristics, the immortality characteristics that cannot be killed no matter how hard he is killed."
"Middleman, if I had this ability, I would have taken away Wade's immortality and used it myself."
Sithorn said angrily: "This is not a difficult job for you, but a job that is impossible to do. In fact, I don't understand why Wade can't die at all, let alone stripping away this ability.
Sorry, middleman, I can't help you with this. Please make other requests. "
